activities.label: Require SBOMs in procurement contracts
activities.question: Do your procurement contracts and dependency-adoption policy require suppliers to provide an SBOM? Please provide the clause.
activities.detail: SECURITY.md carries a dependency-adoption policy requiring a pinned lockfile, an identifiable licence, a resolvable supplying organisation and a passing audit. We hold no commercial procurement contracts, so the contractual half of 3.3.1.4 is not applicable rather than met.

activities.label: Train development teams on SSDLC practice
activities.question: Is SSDLC and supply-chain security training delivered to development teams, and how often? Please provide the most recent attendance record.
activities.detail: No SSDLC training programme is run. This is a single-repository project with no development team to train.

activities.label: Establish an accountable governance body
activities.question: Which body is accountable for software supply-chain security, who chairs it, and how often does it meet? Please provide its terms of reference.
activities.detail: No accountable governance body exists. There is no board, no chair and no terms of reference.
